message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: "Test Suite"
on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    name: cargo test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      - name: Cache Cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - run: cargo test --all-features

  # Check formatting with rustfmt
  formatting:
    name: cargo fmt
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      # Ensure rustfmt is installed and setup problem matcher
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - name: Rustfmt Check
        uses: actions-rust-lang/rustfmt@v1
",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `cargo test --all-features` on every push and PR, which downloads and compiles dependencies each time. The repository has a Cargo.lock file (provided in context) and a multi-crate workspace, satisfying the preconditions for dependency caching (repeated dependency fetching, lockfile as cache key). Evidence from P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Go modules caching) and P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE (pip caching) demonstrates that caching dependency download directories with actions/cache@v4 reduces job runtime. Adding a cache step for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git keyed by Cargo.lock preserves all test coverage and formatting checks while avoiding repeated downloads.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
